semiconductor_relevance: High — Fraunhofer IZM ASSID specializes in advanced 3D wafer-level system integration and packaging, which is critical for modern semiconductor applications.
summary: Fraunhofer IZM ASSID focuses on 3D wafer-level system integration and packaging, utilizing cutting-edge Cu-Through Silicon Via (TSV) technology. Their state-of-the-art 300mm process line supports the development and manufacturing of complex 3D systems for high-performance applications.
